page_map: PDF page = (odd column + 13) / 2, confirmed on every page of this range by the printed corner numbers (p.207 = 401/402 ... p.213 = 413/414).
second_witness: none on disk. Every letter-level finding below is single-witness. No [sic:] was fired in this range. One [var:] (0411B, a quoted verse whose WORDS diverge) and one [cj:] (0411A, Migne's double negative) were fired, both on columns read here.

reads.source: archive PDF p.207. CALIBRATION: printed corner numbers read FIRST -- left 401, right 402, running head 'POENITENTIALIS LIB. I.' Whole page at 1/3 scale, then eight 300 dpi strips (four per column) plus 2.5-3x zooms at 0402A and 0402C.
reads.found: Foot of page: Migne's note (a) on the title banner, 'Affert Wilkins, tom. I Conc. Britan. ... ut indocti ea facile intelligere possent.', running across both columns. This is one of the six recovered notes; our [cn: a] matches it. No other note. Collated word by word against chunk 0000 from the title to CAPUT II ('consideret in tribus'). Title banner set as SANCTI EGBERTI / EBORACENSIS ARCHIEPISCOPI / (a) POENITENTIALE. / (Mansi, Conc. Collect. tom. XII.). The LIBRI PRIMI PARS PRIMA heading is set mid-page across both columns, so the anchors step back 0402B -> 0401 (known false positive 1). TWO PLATE-vs-TEI DIFFERENCES, both filed as pending patches and followed in the English: (1) 0402A 'qui quovis anno' (TEI 'quovit'); (2) 0402C 'et utatur omnibus aliis cibis' (TEI 'uratur'; the t is damaged but has no r-ear, and the same canon has 'utatur' nine lines lower). Confirmed as printed: '(in) pane et aqua' with Migne's parenthesis; 'licet studio adulterium non committant'; 'qualibet hebdomade'; 'et observa duodecim quadragesimae dies'. Worn sort, not a finding: 'mihi' at 0401B looks like 'mibi'.

Confirmed as printed: *Hodie domui huic salus facta est* (italic, Luke 19:9 word order differs); *Qui per corpus suum peccat, per corpus suum hoc compenset* (italic); 'Prima abstinentia est baptismus ignis'; 'tria jejunia per hebdomadam jejunet duobus diebus ad Vesperam'; 'psalterii psalmum'; 'maxillam suam'; 'vel si volens in somno moechatus sit'; 'detineatur in itinere suo'; 'caracallam cassiatam'. Not readable on this copy: 'nonnulli volunt annum' at 0404A is blotted solid; TEI stands. Worn sort: 'Dei honorem' at 0403C reads like 'Doi'.

reads.source: archive PDF p.211. CALIBRATION: corner numbers read FIRST -- left 409, right 410, running head 'POENITENTIALIS LIB. I.' Whole page at 1/3 scale, then twelve 300 dpi strips, plus a separate 400 dpi render for the 0409B-C checks (3x and 8x crops) and 0410C.
reads.found: Foot of left column: Migne's note (a) '(a) In domo vertendum est, WILKINS.' keyed after 'urit' at 0409C. This is one of the six recovered notes; our [cn: a] matches it (the plate has a comma, not a full stop, before WILKINS). No other note. Collated against chunk 0002 from 'et in quadraginta diebus' to CAPUT XXXVII ('unum pro omni'). TWO PLATE-vs-TEI DIFFERENCES, filed as pending patches and followed in the English: (1) 0409B 'saltem diabolis immolet, jejunet' (TEI garble 'immo' et jejunet'); (2) 0410C 'eucharistiae gratia accedere' (TEI 'gratiae'). THE PREP CANDIDATE at 0409C: the plate sets 'Quicunque fre-|mentum urit'. At 400 dpi and 8x the third glyph is ink-filled with no open eye and has a foot at lower right (a u feature). The chapter head on the same page sets 'fru-|mentum'. INDETERMINATE on this copy: crux, single-witness, no patch, no marker. Confirmed as printed: 'quicunque inimicis assignatum cibum sacrificat'; 'in salutem vivorum, et masculi'; 'et tres jejunium legale'; 'nisi quod excommunicet eum qui nequeunt' (0410B); 'In uno eodemque altari quotidie duas missas celebrare debes'; 'corpus consumpti hominis et mariti'; 'Mulieres sub Brunonis regulis'.

Confirmed as printed: 'neque quas accipiter momorderit, si mortuae inveniantur, non sunt edendae' (the double negative, [cj:] fired); *Abstinete vos a fornicatione, et a suffocato, sanguine et idololatria.* (italic, the [var:] site at 0411A-B); 'Pisces emi possunt'; '(sanandam)'; 'Theodorius dicebat'; 'nesciens devocet'; 'nisi excipe, si omnia non sint quam certissime pura'; '(testium)'; *Quocunque die homo ad piam vitam revertitur, vivet, et non morietur* (italic); 'Furi necesse est'. Not settled on this copy: 'et postea sciat' at 0412B looks like 'sciet', but 'cantet' in the same line looks like 'cantot'. TEI stands.

The page runs on into CAPUT XII, which belongs to stint B.
